This section describes what applies on every shift

Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Standards

The Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps travel for animals calm, careful, and respectful. Staff must greet each traveler in a steady tone, confirm the carrier condition, and support the passenger with clear, simple guidance. When a pet is moved by the ground team, the carrier must be handled gently and kept secure from one service point to the next.

All checks for animal acceptance must be completed with attention to the carrier, the comfort of the pet, and the traveler expectations. If a passenger appears worried, the service agent must listen patiently, answer only with approved information, and bring in the supervisor when reassurance is needed. Staff must not make side comments, rush the exchange, or suggest a workaround that has not been approved.

For reptile travel, <<FACT F078>> Staff must apply the inserted rule exactly as provided and continue with the remaining check in steps in a calm, orderly manner. Any concern about health, restraint, or suitability must be referred to the supervisor before the booking proceeds.

Water bowls may be offered only when they are clean, stable, and suitable for the carrier layout. They must never spill into the interior space or interfere with inspection. If a bowl is refused or removed, the reason must be explained in plain language and with courtesy. The desk must keep the animal area tidy, reduce noise where possible, and protect the dignity of every traveler and pet.

When a situation is unclear, the agent must pause and seek direction rather than guess. Any unusual condition, including distress, injury, or a carrier that does not meet standard expectations, must be reported at once through the normal service channel. For further direction, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways.
